We offer playground swings, merry-go-rounds, sandboxes, play houses, multifunctional play equipment, inclusive playgrounds, sand and water play sets, and many more. We provide playgrounds for toddlers aged 1+ and for older children aged 3+. In our standard offer, we have over 1000 products, but to meet the needs and demands of our clients, we eagerly engage in special design projects. Lars Laj also produces outdoor fitness equipment for adults as well as sports arenas. Among our products, you can also find concrete skate parks, pump tracks, trampolines, and other play and sports equipment. We have a wide selection of street furniture too, such as benches, tables, city bins, bike stands, and more. So we provide almost everything to create an amazing recreational facility. Our factory meets the ISO 9001:2015 standards and has received the ISO certificate. Lars Laj's playgrounds are certified yearly by the German TÜV organization according to the acknowledged European norm EN 1176. Our main topic of interest is wooden playgrounds that we make from durable larch wood and robinia wood. Other materials that we use are carefully selected and of high quality to ensure that the products will last for years.

short_overview: UNIFER A/S is a Danish manufacturer and supplier of customized steel reinforcement solutions for the concrete and construction industry. Established in 1954 and based in Svenstrup, near Aalborg, the company specializes in products such as cut and bent reinforcement bars, welded reinforcement meshes, stirrups, and special prefabricated cages. UNIFER combines decades of experience with modern production technology to ensure high product quality, flexible logistics, and short delivery times—often within 24 hours. Their in-house technical team offers expert sparring and customized support for complex construction projects across Denmark. The company is certified by FORCE Certification and Globecert and emphasizes sustainable operations through the use of green electricity, documentation of material origin, and EPD environmental declarations. UNIFER’s strategic focus is on innovation, speed, and long-term partnerships. By offering precise, made-to-measure reinforcement solutions, the company helps construction professionals reduce waste, save time, and increase structural quality on-site. With a strong commitment to service, technical know-how, and environmentally responsible production, UNIFER is a trusted partner in modern construction.

short_overview: SIGMA is located in Kolding, where we produce high-tech machines and processing plants with complete weighing and dosing systems and temperature control. Sigma operates in accordance with ISO 9001 standards and has been working since 1970 with broad experience in design, manufacturing, delivery, and service when it comes to processing and mixing technology. It is of great importance to Sigma that we are regarded at all levels as a competitive, efficient, and flexible partner who can save the customer from often lengthy delivery times. Through a flat organization, tight administrative control, and effective design and calculation tools, we ensure that the customer experiences a cost saving compared to the prices that competitors quote in the market. Sigma has built a solid and deeply rooted network collaboration with a professional team of subcontractors.

Over the years, we became a leader in the production of micro injection moulds and micro injection parts for the medical industry, especially for LCP and PEEK. In addition, we adapt to our customer's needs. Thanks to our focus on automation, we provide solutions in very short deadlines at affordable prices. We accompany our customers from the beginning of their project to the finished product. Our mother company Dencker A/S is ISO:9001 certified, thus proving the constant high quality of our produced parts. Our other mother company Trend Mould Aps is specialised in moulding of more simple items with standard tolerances in customised control plans. If you are looking for parts that are not directly supplied by A Tech Supply, we resort to outsourcing to select the right supplier amongst our trusted partners. Don't hesitate to contact us for more information! You will benefit from our more than 15 years experience and knowledge in sourcing. Let's work together to find the best solutions to materialize your project.

short_overview: Finap AB is a Swedish company specializing in fish processing. We are based in Norrland, where we passionately and precisely produce high-quality fish products for restaurants, retailers, and grocery stores in Sweden and Europe. The products are manufactured under strict hygiene and quality controls in a facility that is IP-certified and approved for export within the EU. We take pride in combining traditional methods with modern processes to create products with pure flavors and sustainable quality. Our raw materials come from certified suppliers, and we strive for long-term relationships with our customers, built on trust, service, and flexibility. Our strategy is to grow sustainably together with our customers by offering high-quality fish products, the possibility of contract manufacturing, and tailored solutions for different markets. Finap AB is the obvious choice for those seeking a reliable partner in Nordic fish processing.

short_overview: At Sensorbee, we're passionate about making environmental monitoring straightforward and accessible. Based in Linköping, Sweden, we specialize in providing innovative solutions for monitoring noise, dust, vibrations (NDV), air quality, and weather conditions. From air quality monitors and dust monitors to tools trusted by building surveyors and structural engineers, Sensorbee supports a wide range of needs in environmental testing and construction monitoring Sensorbee was founded in 2018 by David Löwenbrand with a clear vision: to make environmental monitoring more accessible and effective. What started as an idea has grown into a company with a dedicated team across Sweden and the Philippines, combining expertise in hardware design, software development, and cloud services. Most of our products are proudly made in Sweden, reflecting our commitment to quality and reliability from day one.

Highlighting Mega Guld's versatility, Michel Sag mentioned that the extensive range of models available at Mega Guld is accessible to everyone and can be particularly beneficial for newcomers, while craftsmen in the sector will find harmony in design models with the many alternative pieces they can discover when visiting our website. Mega Guld, by embracing the principles of price, quality, and speed, offers you a unique world of semi-finished products with over 35,000 parts and models, supported by a robust infrastructure.

With us, you will get access to a wide variety of organic products like Amaranth seeds, Flax seeds, Sesame seeds, Psyllium, Black cumin seeds, Yellow Mustard Seeds, Black Mustard seeds, Pulses, Grains, Herbs and a lot more. All the items on our product list are cultivated adhering to the highest standards of quality control.

short_overview: MSTECH Sweden AB is a trusted engineering consultancy based in Västerås, Sweden, serving clients across Europe and worldwide. We specialize in structural simulations, fatigue analysis, energy optimization, and sustainable product development. Our team of highly experienced industry experts, including PhD-level engineers, brings deep knowledge in structural engineering, energy systems, and material sciences. This expertise enables us to deliver precise, reliable, and cost-effective solutions that help businesses improve product durability, prevent costly failures, and optimize energy use. We are specialized in Finite Element Analysis (FEA), composite simulation, and life cycle assessment (LCA). In addition, we provide sustainable packaging design with paper-based and eco-friendly solutions that combine performance, cost efficiency, and environmental responsibility. MSTECH Sweden works with clients in industries such as: Manufacturing and industrial equipment Renewable energy and power systems Infrastructure and construction Packaging and consumer goods Our approach combines technical accuracy, innovation, and sustainability. We focus on building strong partnerships based on trust, transparency, and results, delivering tailored solutions that support both engineering performance and global sustainability goals.

The company was founded in 1953 by Heinrich Blickle. Since 1967, internationalization has been a consistent goal, and subsidiaries have been established in all major markets. In addition to the headquarters in Rosenfeld, Blickle now has 23 of its own sales companies in Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Australia, as well as exclusive representatives in over 120 countries around the world. The Blickle Group currently has over 1,350 employees worldwide, of which more than 950 are at the headquarters in Rosenfeld, Germany. As a family business, Blickle places great importance on continuity. With Dr. Sarah Blickle-Fenner and David Blickle, the third generation is already involved in the company.
